cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import parse

# More comprehensive tests for digit field numbering (R2)
tests = [
    ('{0}', 'hello'),           # basic positional
    ('{0:d}', '42'),            # positional + type
    ('{0:5d}', '42'),           # positional + width
    ('{0:05d}', '42'),          # positional + zero-pad
    ('{0:s}', 'hello'),         # positional + string
    ('{1:d}', '99'),            # second positional
    ('{0:d}{1:d}', '4299'),     # multiple positional
    ('{name}', 'hello'),        # named (should still work)
    ('{name:d}', '42'),         # named + type (should still work)
    ('{:d}', '42'),             # anonymous + type (should still work)
]

print('=== Testing digit field numbering (R2) ===')
for fmt, val in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, val)
    print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {val!r}) = {r}')
"
